name: sourcedna
description: Trace claim provenance, collapse derivative sources, and measure evidence independence for AI-era research.

interface.longDescription: Analyze factual claims, trace source lineage, identify derivative reporting and synthetic consensus, estimate claim drift, and calculate an experimental Evidence Independence Score. SourceDNA measures evidence independence, not factual truth.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this claim with SourceDNA and tell me how many independent evidence roots support it.
Trace the citations in this answer and check whether they collapse to the same source.
Check this claim for synthetic consensus and claim drift.
